title: 24-Hour Access Membership
source_quote: 24-Hour Access Membership $350/month This membership includes studio access, equipment use, firings, glaze usage, a shelf to store your work and personal items, and a supportive clay community.
evidence_sentence: Members have access to soda firings once a soda firing 101 class has been taken.
evidence_quote: Open studio members have access to soda firings once a soda firing 101 class has been taken
how_to_join: Email featsofclayatx@gmail.com; there may be a waitlist. Requires taking two 6-week or longer courses within a calendar year.
summary: 24-hour studio access membership with soda firing access after completing a soda firing 101 class. Includes equipment use, glaze, and storage shelf.
